app.name: PostureGuard
app.tagline: Watches your posture during work hours and nudges you when you slouch

hint.needCalibText: Sit up straight and press the button below, so the app learns what your good posture looks like.
hint.noPersonText: Make sure the camera can see your head and both shoulders.
hint.offHoursText: The camera is off because it is outside your monitoring schedule.
hint.camLostText: Detection has stopped: the camera may be unplugged or taken by another app, or the inference engine failed.

overlay.sitBody: You have been sitting for {n} minutes. Stand up and move for 3 minutes.
overlay.meta: Dismisses itself once your posture is back
overlay.previewBody: This screen is {w}×{h}. When your posture slips, the card shows up at this spot.

log.modelCpu: GPU unavailable, fell back to CPU
log.camEnum: Trying devices one by one, {n} found
log.camAllFail: No camera device could be opened
log.camStall: Camera feed stopped updating, detection halted
log.calibSaved: Calibration saved, no need to redo it next launch
log.calibInterrupted: Calibration interrupted: no one in frame
log.calibIncomplete: The saved calibration is incomplete, please redo it
log.calibCameraMismatch: The calibration was captured for "{from}" but the current position is "{to}", please redo it
log.calibExpired: The calibration is over 7 days old, please redo it
log.baselineDropped: Camera position changed, the old calibration is void, please redo it
log.hotkeyFail: No global shortcut could be registered, use the Pause button in the window

set.title: Settings
set.baselineNone: No calibration saved yet. One is written after you complete a calibration.
set.baselineSaved: Saved calibration: {where}, {when}. Usable within 7 days if the camera position stays the same.
set.scheduleNote: Setting both ends of a slot to 00:00 disables it. The camera is released outside these hours.
set.presetNote: The level is judged from all six numbers — change any one and it becomes Custom. Switching the camera position resets four angle thresholds, so it lands here too.
set.thresholdNote: Larger values are more forgiving. If unsure, only adjust neck forward angle first.
set.displayNote: The nudge appears in the center of the chosen screen. If that screen disappears, it falls back to the largest one.
set.opacityNote: Lower it to see the desktop behind the card. The trade-off: over dense text, the card's own text gets harder to read.
set.cameraNote: The position decides the four recommended thresholds. Changing it resets the thresholds and voids the calibration.
set.cameraGuide: Confirm the camera position: currently treated as "{cur}". If the laptop sits beside you, switch to the matching front-left / front-right 45° — a wrong position skews both the calibration and the thresholds.
set.displayGuide: Multiple screens detected. Pick one, then hit Preview — the card will really show up on that screen.

about.title: About
about.privacy: Camera frames are processed in memory on this machine only — never recorded, uploaded or written to disk. Settings and calibration live in a local config file.
about.license: MIT licensed. Free to use, modify and redistribute.
about.donateText: This app is free, open source and ad-free. If it saved your neck a little, scan the code below to buy the author a coffee — no sign-up needed.
about.donateTerms: This is a voluntary gift: not a purchase, and it carries no service obligation or reward of any kind.
about.donateHint: Scan in WeChat. Up to 200 CNY per payment.
about.donateUnset: The author has not set up a sponsorship channel. A star on GitHub counts too.
about.donateAlt: Want to give more, or need an order record? Afdian is the other option.
